seoTitle: Line Break Remover: Unwrap Text Copied from PDF or Email
metaDescription: Join hard-wrapped lines back into paragraphs, keep real paragraph breaks and bullet lists, and mend hyphenated words. Free, in your browser.
intro: Join text copied from a PDF or email back into flowing paragraphs, keeping real paragraph breaks, bullet lists and optionally mending hyphenated words.
why:
Text copied from a PDF or a plain-text email breaks at every line end. Pasting it into a document gives a ragged column of short lines.

This tool joins the lines of each paragraph, keeps blank-line paragraph breaks, can keep bullets and numbered items on their own lines, and joins words split with a hyphen at the line end. Or remove every break. A word such as well-known that happens to break at its hyphen is also joined, so check the result.
howTo: Choose whether to mend hyphenated line ends and keep list items.
Tick the last option to get one single line.

faq.a: A hyphen at a line end followed by a lowercase letter is treated as a split word. A real compound such as well-known may lose its hyphen, so read the result.
A blank line starts a new paragraph. Text with no blank lines becomes one paragraph.
No. Only line breaks, spaces and split hyphens change.
